propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the recall-handling procedure and the compliance check definitions and tested them with three volunteer partners in the portal's sandbox tenant.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the sandbox outcome sheet document the definitions and the testing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the monthly compliance review with legal and partner management and recorded outcomes in the review log.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the review work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate rolled out the compliance checks to the live partner network and operates the live checks.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the testing in a sandbox tenant and the live release with the portal product team; the LinkedIn wording and the screen remark describe the checks' status, not a deployment by the candidate.

expectedGap: The materials document sandbox testing and procedure definition; they do not document the candidate releasing checks to the live network or operating them there.
expectedBoundaryNote: Preserve the environment the resume names: sandbox testing by the candidate, live release by the portal product team after legal sign-off.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has executed a release to the live partner network herself or operated live checks, and for which releases.
